title: korthalsella complanata
intro: Korthalsella complanata, commonly known as the "cushion bush," is a succulent plant species that belongs to the Santalaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to help manage fever, reduce inflammation, and support digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Korthalsella complanata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, among others. Furthermore, the plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and skin infections, although more research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
